40.out:
Presets

+- airgapped --------------------------+
| Simulates an air-gapped workspace    |
| with no Rocket.Chat Cloud            |
| connectivity. The Cloud URL and      |
| workspace credentials point at non-  |
| routable placeholders, so cloud      |
| sync, registration and marketplace   |
| calls never reach out. Use to        |
| reproduce offline / disconnected-    |
| workspace behaviour.                 |
+--------------------------------------+

+- default ----------------------------+
| Vanilla Rocket.Chat, ready to use    |
| immediately: setup wizard skipped    |
| and an admin user auto-created       |
| (admin / admin123).                  |
+--------------------------------------+

+- email ------------------------------+
| Mailpit mailcatcher wired to RC's    |
| SMTP. Every email RC sends -         |
| password resets, invites,            |
| verification, notification and 2FA   |
| mail - is captured at                |
| http://localhost:8025 (at /mailpit/  |
| on an HTTPS workspace) instead of    |
| leaving the machine. Pair with       |
| --seed for users with verified       |
| emails.                              |
|                                      |
| --set verification   require email   |
|                      verification on |
|                      new accounts    |
|                      (default false) |
+--------------------------------------+

+- ldap -------------------------------+
| OpenLDAP (osixia) seeded with 5      |
| user(s) + group 'rc-users'; RC wired |
| for LDAP login. Log in as user1 /    |
| user1.                               |
|                                      |
| --set users       number of LDAP     |
|                   users to generate  |
|                   (default 5; try    |
|                   130000 for scale)  |
| --set domain      LDAP domain        |
|                   (default           |
|                   example.com)       |
| --set groups      'on' adds groups   |
|                   rocket-chat (every |
|                   user but the       |
|                   last), rocket-     |
|                   admin (user1) and  |
|                   employee           |
|                   (everyone), and    |
|                   lets only rocket-  |
|                   chat log in        |
|                   (default off)      |
| --set bind        'service' binds    |
|                   Rocket.Chat as a   |
|                   read-only          |
|                   directory user,    |
|                   whom slapd limits  |
|                   to 500 entries per |
|                   search, as many    |
|                   real directories   |
|                   do (default        |
|                   'admin',           |
|                   unlimited)         |
| --set tls         'ldaps' (port 636) |
|                   or 'starttls'      |
|                   (389), with a      |
|                   certificate from   |
|                   houston's own CA   |
|                   (default none)     |
| --set trust       'none' leaves      |
|                   houston's CA out   |
|                   of Rocket.Chat, to |
|                   reproduce a        |
|                   certificate error  |
|                   (default           |
|                   'houston')         |
| --set directory   'ad' serves the    |
|                   same users from    |
|                   Samba as Active    |
|                   Directory:         |
|                   sAMAccountName,    |
|                   objectGUID, nested |
|                   groups (default    |
|                   'openldap')        |
| --set idp         'saml' or 'oidc'   |
|                   puts Keycloak in   |
|                   front of this      |
|                   directory, so the  |
|                   same users also    |
|                   sign in by SSO     |
|                   (default none)     |
| --set mfa         'on' has Keycloak  |
|                   ask for a one-time |
|                   code at SSO sign-  |
|                   in; needs idp      |
|                   (default off)      |
| --set idp_host    with idp: hostname |
|                   your browser       |
|                   reaches Keycloak   |
|                   on (default as the |
|                   saml and oidc      |
|                   presets:           |
|                   localhost, or      |
|                   keycloak for oidc) |
+--------------------------------------+

+- livechat ---------------------------+
| Rocket.Chat Omnichannel with the     |
| Livechat widget embedded on a        |
| separate demo website                |
| (http://localhost:8090). Reproduce   |
| widget-load / CORS / routing /       |
| agent-availability tickets. Admin is |
| the agent.                           |
|                                      |
| --set agents         agents to       |
|                      create + assign |
|                      to the          |
|                      department      |
|                      (default 1;     |
|                      admin is always |
|                      an agent)       |
| --set registration   show the pre-   |
|                      chat            |
|                      registration    |
|                      form (default   |
|                      false)          |
| --set department     create a        |
|                      'support'       |
|                      department +    |
|                      assign the      |
|                      agents (default |
|                      true)           |
+--------------------------------------+

+- oidc -------------------------------+
| Keycloak OIDC IdP (OpenID Connect)   |
| with 5 users user1..user5            |
| (password=username). RC logs in via  |
| Custom OAuth (popup). Click          |
| 'Keycloak (OIDC)', sign in as        |
| user1/user1. See the note printed on |
| `up` for how the browser reaches the |
| IdP.                                 |
|                                      |
| --set users      number of Keycloak  |
|                  test users (default |
|                  5)                  |
| --set idp_host   hostname BOTH your  |
|                  browser and         |
|                  Rocket.Chat reach   |
|                  Keycloak on         |
|                  (default            |
|                  'keycloak', which   |
|                  needs a hosts entry |
|                  and only works on   |
|                  this machine)       |
